title: Story pack: could you find your best 2026 ad by its file name?
hook: Could you find your best ad of 2026 by its file name?
caption:
Story pack (no feed caption).

A quick tip for the first working week: name ads so they can be sorted later. Frame 2 is the poll. Frame 3 gives the five things to put in every ad name. Frame 4 says why it pays off.
alt_text: Five vertical story frames. Frame 1 asks: could you find your best ad of 2026 by its file name? Frame 2 is a poll on what your ad names look like. Frame 3 lists five things to put in every ad name: buyer, reason to buy, first shot, format and month. Frame 4: a name you can sort is a lesson you can find. Frame 5: start with the next ad you launch.
cta: Vote in the poll; screenshot the list
